name: Wine Valley Golf Club
location: Walla Walla, Walla Walla County, Washington

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP elevation service (3DEPElevation ImageServer exportImage, 1 m, EPSG:32611, box x 382700-384800 / y 5100700-5102600); the 1 m DEM under the course is WA_3_County_QL1_2017 (tile x38y511, flown 2017-10-03 to 2018-07-04, published 2020-03-30, per the service's identify); fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-wine_valley, usgs_dem_m.tif)

laz.source: USGS Lidar Point Cloud USGS_LPC_WA_3_County_QL2_2017_LAS_2019, 9 tiles from rockyweb.usgs.gov, fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-wine_valley), each clipped to the world + 100 m by intake.py laz --keep-evlrs; NAD83(2011) / Washington South (US ft), NAVD88 US ft; classes 1 (unclassified: vegetation and structures), 2 ground, 7 noise: no vegetation classes
laz.label: 2017 USGS Washington 3 County lidar

ortho.source: USDA NAIP from the USGS National Map NAIP ImageServer (exportImage, about 0.6 m, EPSG:32611), two JPEG exports placed by their request boxes (intake.py ortho); fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-wine_valley)

world.note: OSM course boundary (way 436979104, 1,550 x 1,395 m in EPSG:32611) + 120 m of scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred

scorecard_source: GolfPass, Wine Valley Golf Course scorecard (read 2026-11-13): Gold 7,600 yd, men's rating 76.4 / slope 133, men's par and handicap rows; the Gold row adds up to its total; Cabernet, Black, Merlot, Blue, Syrah, White, Chardonnay and Red in scorecard.csv, not built. Unverified (third party; the club's card is not online). Greenskeeper.org (read 2026-11-13) has an older Gold row (7,360 yd, 75.5/130; 1 430, 2 390, 5 475, 8 225, 9 455, 14 160, 17 420, 18 565) and another men's handicap row (5 11 7 15 1 17 9 13 3 / 8 16 4 2 18 12 14 6 10): open item. OSM's pars agree with the card.
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (Washington 3 County 2017 lidar)
Imagery check: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP)
rough_band_note: a mown band of rough along the fairways, then the golden native bunchgrass of the hill faces (theme F tones)
